title: Follow an ERD entity to its feature behavior and code
preconditions: Disposable format-2 Saga using the PDF inventory fixture: implemented PDF report held by Record store, proposed JSON PDF job held by Job queue, report-to-job production relationship, application ERD, and pdf-jobs overlay; the reporting ERD also includes a job association with owner 0..many and destination unknown.
An implementation deck Item explicitly uses the report entity and selects its exact report code; a second deck reuses that identity.

steps.action: Open report from the ERD, inspect its code location and currency, and expand reverse usages.
steps.expected_result: Details show source commit/path/range and health; usages name feature, deck, slide and Item.

steps.action: Follow a usage to its slide and Item, read the feature-specific explanation, then open the selected code.
steps.expected_result: The feature behavior and deeper code remain linked to the same canonical report identity.

expected_result: The feature behavior and deeper code remain linked to the same canonical report identity.
